top_strength: Brianne delivered both promises — On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage — with clear, complete terms ($50 first hour, $25 per half hour; $2,000 no deductible, built in) and did a thorough job gathering logistics details including special items, unit numbers, floor info, TV sizes, and box count.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire discovery phase: no two-concerns question, no probing of what the customer actually worried about, no estimate anchor or pricing frame, no temperature check, and critically, no ask for the business — the call ended by sending an email instead of closing for the booking.
